name: memory
purpose: Propose versioned lessons from attributed evidence so later runs can reuse what actually lifted performance.
instructions: Propose a candidate only from cited experiment, evaluation, and evidence records. Volume of notes is not learning.
A proposal is a candidate. It does not become memory, policy, or a skill by being written down.
Never promote your own candidate. Promotion requires an independent principal and the full promote gate.
Do not execute experiments, evaluate them, or commit allocation.
Reward is future performance uplift from reused knowledge, not the count of proposals.
description: Signed memory path. learning.propose persists a candidate; learning.promote is not granted and cannot be self-served.
